title: CoSkill: Joint Reinforcement Learning of Reasoning and Meta-Skill Agents for Hierarchical Skill Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.04865v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Skill libraries improve the sample efficiency of agentic reinforcement learning (RL) by enabling large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedural knowledge. Yet existing paradigms exhibit structural shortcomings: they either decouple skill evolution from policy optimization or instantiate meta-skills as fixed workflows. Both treat skills as passive objects to be managed, limiting the flexible evolution of skills and their co-adaptation with the reasoning agent. To address the limitations, we propose CoSkill, a unified multi-agent RL framework that recasts the static meta-skill workflow as a learnable Meta-Skill Agent and jointly trains it with a Reasoning Agent over a hierarchical skill library. translated_title: CoSkill：面向分层技能演化的推理与元技能智能体联合强化学习
translated_abstract: 技能库通过使大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够复用程序性知识，提升了智能体强化学习（RL）的样本效率。然而，现有范式存在结构性缺陷：它们要么将技能演化与策略优化解耦，要么将元技能实例化为固定的工作流。这两种方式都将技能视为被管理的被动对象，限制了技能的灵活演化及其与推理智能体的协同适应。为解决这些局限，我们提出了CoSkill，一个统一的多智能体强化学习框架，它将静态的元技能工作流重新构建为可学习的元技能智能体，并在分层技能库上与推理智能体进行联合训练。通过将推理智能体与元技能智能体建模为共享同一骨干网络的协作团队，CoSkill实现了端到端的协同适应：推理智能体根据检索到的任务技能以及从中选择的步骤技能来调整其行动
tldr: 提出CoSkill框架，将固定工作流式的元技能重构为可学习的元技能智能体，与推理智能体组成共享单一骨干网络的协作团队进行联合强化学习，从而实现分层技能库中技能与推理策略的端到端协同演化。
en_tdlr: CoSkill recasts meta-skills as a learnable Meta-Skill Agent jointly trained with a Reasoning Agent as a cooperative team sharing a single backbone, enabling end-to-end co-adaptation for hierarchical skill evolution.
